messages.author: 674f7739b90d04f0
messages.subject: Re: Shiny R over  Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server release 6.3 (Santiago)
parts:
Hi,

This worked for me:

1) Install EPEL repos
su -c 'rpm -Uvh http://download.fedoraproject.org/pub/epel/6/i386/epel-release-6-8.noarch.rpm'

2) Get Dependencies - For some unknown reason there are a few packages R needs which do not exist in the RHEL repositories. Somebody at SO suggested to get them from the CentOS repos and that solved all the dependencies issues.

wget http://mirror.centos.org/centos/6/os/x86_64/Packages/lapack-devel-3.2.1-4.el6.x86_64.rpm
wget http://mirror.centos.org/centos/6/os/x86_64/Packages/blas-devel-3.2.1-4.el6.x86_64.rpm
wget http://mirror.centos.org/centos/6/os/x86_64/Packages/texinfo-tex-4.13a-8.el6.x86_64.rpm
wget http://mirror.centos.org/centos/6/os/x86_64/Packages/libicu-devel-4.2.1-9.1.el6_2.x86_64.rpm
sudo yum localinstall *.rpm

3) Install R
yum install R

Carlos
